name: 32221 · Jacksonville, FL
findings: ZIP 32221 (Jacksonville) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32221 (Jacksonville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
